title: Session switcher — even spacing on both sides

steps.path: The session switcher at the top of the window (shown 3x larger)
steps.headline: The open session's name now has the same space after it as before its dot.
steps.changed: The blank strip after the name shrank to match the space before the dot. Before, the right side was about 12px wider than the left.
steps.measured: Right side 19 px → 7 px; left side 7 px (unchanged)
steps.notice: The name pill looks centred and is 12px narrower, so a longer name fits before it has to fade out.
steps.risk: When a name is too long and fades out at the end, the fade is shorter (7px instead of 12px), so the cut-off looks slightly sharper.

steps.path: The session switcher at the top of the window (shown 3x larger)
steps.headline: Each session dot is now centred in its space, so the dots sit evenly.
steps.changed: Each dot had 4px of extra empty space on its right. That space is gone, so every dot is 4px narrower and centred.
steps.measured: Each dot 28 px → 24 px wide; ten dots take 40 px less room
steps.notice: The row of dots is tighter and even. In a narrow window, a few more sessions fit before the "+N" bubble appears.
steps.risk: Dragging a pill past a dot now swaps at the dot's new centre (2px sooner). The automatic drag test found no new problems, but it's worth one drag to check it feels the same.
